purpose: Research-only candidate inventory for the 2026-11-08 L4 rerun. This is a screening list, not permission to use every checkpoint.

candidates.name: FLAIR
candidates.terms_status: Official repository states FLAIR code and model weights are Apache-2.0. Preserve the source-dataset provenance limitations; do not infer rights to redistribute derived data.
candidates.availability_status: Probe complete on Golden Retina L4; frozen features/readouts and aggregate summary recorded. Public checkpoint and source commit hashes verified.
candidates.decision: Completed internal train/validation probe. Mixed results; retain as a comparator, not selected as the leading candidate based on these metrics.

candidates.name: DINOv2
candidates.terms_status: Official facebookresearch/dinov2 repository ships Apache-2.0 terms; checkpoint source and hash are recorded; probe is research-only.
candidates.availability_status: Probe complete on Golden Retina L4; metrics and provenance are in results/technical_dev_20261108_rerun/dinov2_aggregate_summary.json.
candidates.decision: Retain as a general-encoder comparator; not selected to lead based on current development validation because DR and grade metrics were below ConvNeXt.

candidates.name: DINOv3
candidates.terms_status: Model-specific DINOv3 license; gated model access and licensee eligibility/acceptance remain unresolved.
candidates.availability_status: Gated; access/acceptance not confirmed; excluded from this run.
candidates.decision: Do not download/use until the authorized account holder has access and accepts the exact terms; current candidate slot reallocated.

candidates.name: RETFound-MAE
candidates.terms_status: Model card states CC BY-NC 4.0; account-level gated access is approved for Burak8159. Use only for noncommercial research; not for clinical/commercial deployment; do not redistribute the checkpoint.
candidates.availability_status: Official checkpoint access verified and frozen-feature probe complete; starting last-block supervised adaptation on L4. Checkpoint remains private.
candidates.decision: Continue noncommercial research adaptation. Frozen development metrics are below ConvNeXt for DR; fine-tuning is exploratory and validation-selected only.

candidates.name: RETFound-DINOv2
candidates.terms_status: Model card states CC BY-NC 4.0. Exact file access is not approved for the authenticated account (403 from Mac and L4). The model card reports pretraining on part of SDPP; overlap with this project’s sources is unresolved.
candidates.availability_status: Authenticated requests for the exact checkpoint returned 403 from both Mac and L4.
candidates.decision: Cannot be used until publisher grants account access; access controls will not be bypassed.

candidates.name: RETFound-DINOv3
candidates.family: retinal foundation encoder initialized from DINOv3
candidates.terms_status: Model card reports CC BY-NC 4.0; access is gated. Verify upstream DINOv3 obligations and the exact accepted terms.
candidates.availability_status: Official RETFound-DINOv3 checkpoint is gated; upstream DINOv3 terms also apply. Excluded; no gated download attempted.
candidates.decision: Include conditionally after access is granted and the derivative-weight license is reviewed.

candidates.name: VisionFM
candidates.terms_status: CC BY-NC 4.0 / research-education-only conditions recorded in prior project review; no commercial or clinical-decision use and no weight redistribution.
candidates.availability_status: Probe complete on frozen 7,671-row manifest; aggregate metrics saved in results/technical_dev_20261108_rerun/visionfm_aggregate_summary.json.
candidates.decision: Retain as research comparator; not selected as lead because current-manifest DR and glaucoma validation are below ConvNeXt and DR transfer is below FLAIR.

candidates.name: UrFound
candidates.family: multimodal retinal foundation encoder (fundus and OCT)
candidates.terms_status: Official repository exposes an MIT license for the code; verify the exact checkpoint and its training-data obligations separately.
candidates.availability_status: Official public MIT checkpoint staged and hash verified; probe running on L4, 1,024/7,671 embeddings extracted; checkpoint reports epoch 199.
candidates.decision: Add as a candidate; include only after checkpoint provenance and terms check.

candidates.name: OPENEye-FM
candidates.terms_status: Model card declares MIT; intended for research and expressly not for direct clinical diagnosis or autonomous screening. Its training-data manifest contains many source datasets whose terms need separate review.
candidates.availability_status: Official 461,781,163-byte checkpoint downloaded privately on L4; SHA-256 6625ff53dfa9dbce9507dd42310efbf06ea12e4307dab5f443a203c4ac8958d0. Validation-only inference completed; aggregate summary saved locally.
candidates.decision: Exploratory DRTiD/HYGD transfer only. DRTiD DR AUROC 0.922/AUPRC 0.923 (n=500), but 27 misses at fixed 0.5; HYGD glaucoma AUROC 0.787 and 67 misses (n=125). DeepDRiD and DDR validation excluded due stated pretraining overlap; exact-image overlap for retained sources unknown. Not a clinical model.

candidates.name: RETFound-Green
candidates.terms_status: Public checkpoint; repository has a model-specific custom license. Read and record its exact restrictions before use; do not infer terms from RETFound or DINOv2.
candidates.availability_status: Not downloaded: official custom licence excludes some industry-involved projects; eligibility for this sponsored/pilot project remains unresolved.
candidates.decision: Blocked unless the project is demonstrably eligible or the licensor grants prior written permission; continue to next candidate.

candidates.name: EyeCLIP
candidates.terms_status: Repository advertises released weights, but an explicit weight license was not established in this screening. Treat as rights-unverified until the official weight terms are confirmed.
candidates.availability_status: Removed from active plan by user direction; no gated/unverified weights were accessed or downloaded.
candidates.decision: Excluded from this run. Retained in the inventory for audit history only.

candidates.name: RET-CLIP
candidates.terms_status: Repository releases pretrained weights, but this screening did not establish an explicit license for those weights or all dependencies.
candidates.availability_status: Removed from active plan by user direction; no gated/unverified weights were accessed or downloaded.
candidates.decision: Excluded from this run. Retained in the inventory for audit history only.

candidates.name: EyeFound
candidates.terms_status: No official, clearly reusable weight license/access route confirmed in this screening.
candidates.availability_status: Removed from active plan by user direction; no gated/unverified weights were accessed or downloaded.
candidates.decision: Excluded from this run. Retained in the inventory for audit history only.

candidates.name: RFM (Lightweight Retinal Foundation Model)
candidates.family: retinal foundation encoder initialized from DINOv3
candidates.terms_status: Official project states derived weights are under the DINOv3 license; its code's MIT license does not replace the weight license.
candidates.availability_status: Removed from active plan by user direction; no gated/unverified weights were accessed or downloaded.
candidates.decision: Excluded from this run. Retained in the inventory for audit history only.

explicit_exclusions: No checkpoint is included just because the repository code is permissively licensed.
No gated agreement is accepted on the user's behalf.
No weights or derived checkpoints are redistributed.
Models whose exact weight terms remain unclear stay listed but are not staged for training until clarified.
source_notes: Candidate-specific terms differ between source code, pretrained weights, and training datasets.
User authorized noncommercial research use; this does not override third-party access gates or license terms.
